instruction: Help me open the mp4 video and pause at 1:01.
evaluator: result=$(osascript -e 'tell application "QuickTime Player" to get current time of document 1' 2>/dev/null); if [[ $result =~ ^[0-9]*\.[0-9]+$ ]] && (( $(echo "$result > 58" | bc -l) )) && (( $(echo "$result < 65" | bc -l) )); then echo "True"; else echo "False"; fi
